_comment: Example of settings.json. The app creates the real file in your data folder (Windows: %APPDATA%\IsoResearchAI\settings.json). Edit it via Settings in the app, or copy this file there while the app is closed.

profile.research_area: Water isotope hydrology and isotope-enabled regional atmospheric modelling.
profile.primary_location: Port Blair, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, India.
profile.primary_observations: Rainfall water isotopes from 2024–2026, including δ18O, δ2H, and derived d-excess when available.
profile.modelling_interests: Isotope-enabled regional modelling, especially IsoRSM, with alternative models considered when appropriate.
profile.related_observations: Rainfall amount, rainfall intensity, event evolution, meteorological variables, moisture transport, and back trajectories where available.
profile.scientific_objective: Evaluate simulated rainfall isotope variability against observations, investigate physical processes controlling isotope variability, and identify defensible research questions.
